How I Became An Ontologist

Released Sep 29, 2025, 19 min

Play How I Became An Ontologist on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

This video covers the important influences from grad school, to interviewing, to accepting myself as a career ontologist. I'll do follow up videos soon on what steps I'd advise others to take, and how I feel about leaving academia.

Thanks to Ben J for his feedback to me on my channel, and his request that I do a "how to be an ontologist" series. I hope this covers some of what he wanted!
